newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SAIL posts all-time high H1 output.
newsitem.headline: India's SAIL posts all-time high H1 output.

text.p: The state-run Steel Authority of India Limited said on Wednesday it recorded an all-time high output in the first six months of the financial year 1996/97 (April-March).

SAIL produced 6.13 million tonnes of hot metal, 5.4 million tonnes of crude steel and 4.7 million tonnes of saleable steel showing a rise of 6.0 per cent, 4.0 per cent and 5.0 per cent respectively over the April-September period in 1995, SAIL said in a statement.
The statement did not give the comparative production figures for 1995/96.
"SAIL pumped into the market an additional 200,000 tonnes of saleable steel during the first six months of the current financial year," the statement said.

SAIL said its five plants and two subsidiary units together recorded their best September output by producing 800,000 tonnes of saleable steel, a rise of 5.0 percent over the corresponding month last year.

The production of hot metal was 1.09 million tonnes and crude steel 950,000 tonnes during the month, higher by 14 percent and 12 percent respectively compared to the same month of 1995, the statement said.
